exposed_facts: Energy-based models assign scalar energy to configurations and learn by lowering energy on data and raising it elsewhere.

answer_mechanism: The critic shapes the energy landscape by pushing data down and samples up. The energy model learns to produce low-energy samples that fool the critic.
